become-a-resident.earn: meel kasta oo aad ka tirsan tahay waxay kugu soo dhoweyn doonaan qof aqoon u leh nidaamka
become-a-resident.step.0.label: Is-diiwaangeli
become-a-resident.step.0.what: Qof cusub ayaa akoon ku samaysta madasha.
become-a-resident.step.0.you: Ku qor magacaaga iyo iimaylkaaga si aad akoon u samaysato.
become-a-resident.step.1.label: Ku dhawaaq halka aad deggan tahay
become-a-resident.step.1.what: Waxaad magacawdaa goobta gaarka ah ee aad deggan tahay.
become-a-resident.step.1.you: Raadi xuduud awoodeedkaaga guriga, ka dibna xulo.
become-a-resident.step.2.label: Xaqiijinta joogitaanka
become-a-resident.step.2.what: Qalabkaagu wuxuu diraa calaamad goobta ah si loo xaqiijiyo inaad jir ahaan joogto halka aad ku dhawaaqday.
become-a-resident.step.2.you: U oggolaan app-ka inuu hal mar akhriyo goobtaada.
become-a-resident.step.3.label: Degganaansho la xaqiijiyay
become-a-resident.step.3.what: Sarkaalka loo xilsaaray ayaa dib u eegaya codsigaaga degganaansho, waana xaqiijinayaa.
become-a-resident.step.3.you: La soco xaaladda degganaanshahaaga oo ka beddelmaysa sugitaanuna u gudub xaqiijin.
become-a-resident.step.4.label: Waxaad ka muuqataa heer kasta
become-a-resident.step.4.what: Nidaamku wuxuu kugu xirayaa heer kasta oo dawladdeed oo ka sarreeya goobta aad ku dhawaaqday.
become-a-resident.step.4.you: Fur diiwaankaaga si aad u aragto dhammaan golal iyo dawlado aad hadda ka tirsan tahay.
become-a-resident.step.5.label: Xuquuqda oo shidma
become-a-resident.step.5.what: Xuquuqdaada codeynta iyo inaad u tartanto xafiis waxay shidmaysaa xuduud awoodeed kasta oo aad ka tirsan tahay.
become-a-resident.step.5.you: Fur diiwaankaaga si aad u aragto xuquuqdaada firfircoon.
become-a-resident.title: Noqoshada degane
become-a-resident.your_part: tani waa tan aad samayso — is-diiwaangeli, ku dhawaaq halka aad deggan tahay, oo u oggolaaw joogitaankaaga inuu xaqiijiyo
bill.earn: kalfaliga sharci-dejinta wuxuu kugu soo dhoweyn doonaa qof aqoon u leh nidaamka
bill.step.0.label: La soo bandhigay
bill.step.0.what: Xubin golaha ka tirsan ayaa qoraysa oo soo gudbinaysa hindise sharci si golaha sharci-dejinta uu uga fekero.
bill.step.0.you: Qor oo soo gudbi hindise sharciyadaada si aad u bilowdo hannaanka sharci-dejinta.
bill.step.1.label: Guddi
bill.step.1.what: Guddiga khuseeya ayaa darsaya hindise sharciga, dhageysanaya markhaatiga, go'aaminayana in loo gudbiyo golaha.
bill.step.1.you: La soco shaqada guddiga, soo gudbi markhaati haddii aad rabto in mowqifkaaga la maqlo.
bill.step.2.label: Akhriska golaha
bill.step.2.what: Qoraalka oo dhammaystiran ee hindise sharciga ayaa loo akhriyaa dhammaan xubnaha ka hor codeynta.
bill.step.2.you: Dib u eeg qoraalka hindise sharciga sida uu ugu soo bandhigay golaha.
bill.step.3.label: Codeynta golaha
bill.step.3.what: Xubin kasta oo golaha ka tirsan ayaa codeynaysa in hindise sharciga la ansixiyo iyo in kale.
bill.step.4.label: La ansixiyay
bill.step.4.what: Hindise sharcigu wuxuu gaaray aqlabiyadda loo baahnaa, waxaana loo diiwaangeliyay sharci cusub.
bill.step.4.you: Dib u eeg sharciga la ansixiyay sida uu ugu muuqdo diiwaanka golaha.
bill.step.5.label: La daabacay
bill.step.5.what: Sharciga waxaa lagu daray diiwaan dadweyne, qof kastaana wuu arki karaa.
bill.step.5.you: Akhri sharciga ku jira diiwaannada dadweynaha.
bill.title: Hindise sharci ayaa noqonaya sharci
board-meeting.earn: kulanka guddiga maamulku wuxuu kugu soo dhoweyn doonaa qof aqoon u leh hannaanka
board-meeting.step.0.label: Kala kulan
board-meeting.step.0.what: Guddoomiyaha guddiga maamulku wuxuu wacayaa kulan, wuxuuna ogeysiinayaa dhammaan xubnaha guddiga.
board-meeting.step.0.you: Ogeysii xubnaha guddiga, kuna xiro taariikhda kulanka bogga ururka.
board-meeting.step.1.label: Qaabdhismeedka
board-meeting.step.1.what: Liiska xubnaha guddiga maamulka ee hadda jira waa la xaqiijinayaa ka hor intaan kulanku bilaaban.
board-meeting.step.1.you: Xaqiiji liiska xubnaha guddiga bogga ururka.
board-meeting.step.2.label: Mooshinnada
board-meeting.step.2.what: Xubnaha guddiga maamulku waxay soo gudbiyaan mooshinnada si ay wax ugu kordhiyaan ajandaha kulanka.
board-meeting.step.2.you: Soo gudbi mooshinkaaga bogga maamulka ururka.
board-meeting.step.3.label: Codeynta guddiga
board-meeting.step.3.what: Guddigu wuxuu u codeeyaa mooshin kasta si is xigta ilaa ajanduhu ka dhammaado.
board-meeting.step.3.you: Ku bixi codeyntaada mooshin kasta oo furan bogga ururka.
board-meeting.step.4.label: Qoraalka kulanka
board-meeting.step.4.what: Qoraalka kulanka waxaa lagu daabacaa diiwaanka ururka.
board-meeting.step.4.you: Akhri qoraalka la daabacay bogga ururka.
board-meeting.title: Qabashada kulanka guddiga maamulka
budget.earn: kalfadhiga sharci-dejintu wuxuu kugu soo dhoweyn doonaa qof aqoon u leh hannaanka
budget.step.0.label: Dakhliga
budget.step.0.what: Golaha sharci-dejintu wuxuu dib u eegayaa dakhliga la saadaaliyay ee xuduud awoodeedka muddadaas.
budget.step.0.you: Akhri koobitaanka khasnadda ee hadda jira bogga maaliyadda dadweynaha.
budget.step.1.label: Hindise sharciga miisaaniyadda
budget.step.1.what: Xubin ayaa soo gudbinaysa hindise sharci soo jeedinaya sida loo isticmaalo lacagaha jira.
budget.step.1.you: Akhri hindise sharciga miisaaniyadda ee la soo gudbiyay bogga hindisayaasha sharciga.
budget.step.2.label: Qoondeynta
budget.step.2.what: Goluhu wuxuu u codeeyaa ansixinta qadarka kharashka ee barnaamij kasta.
budget.step.2.you: La soco codeynta furan ee hindise sharciga qoondeynta.
budget.step.3.label: Bixinta lacagta
budget.step.3.what: Lacagaha la ansixiyay waxay ka wareegaan khasnadda dadweynaha una gudbaan barnaamijyada loo oggolaaday.
budget.step.3.you: La soco bixinta lacagaha bogga maaliyadda dadweynaha.
budget.step.4.label: Buugga xisaabta
budget.step.4.what: Dhaqdhaqaaq kasta waxaa lagu diiwaangeliyaa buugga xisaabta dadweynaha, waxaana loo oggol yahay baaritaan.
budget.step.4.you: Akhri diiwaanka hanti-dhowrka bogga diiwaanka dadweynaha.
budget.title: Ansixinta miisaaniyadda
budget.your_part: tan waad daawanaysaa — goluhu wuxuu qoraa, bixinta lacag kastaana waxay ku dhacdaa buug xisaabeed aad akhrin karto
committee-session.earn: dhageysiga guddigu wuxuu kugu soo dhoweyn doonaa qof aqoon u leh hannaanka
committee-session.step.0.label: Kala kulan
committee-session.step.0.you: Sug inta guddoomiyuhu uu kulanka furayo.
committee-session.step.1.label: Koorum
committee-session.step.1.what: Xubnuhu waxay diiwaangeliyaan imaanshadooda, nidaamkuna wuxuu hubinayaa in aqlabiyad shaqaynaysa ay joogto.
committee-session.step.1.you: Diiwaangeli imaanshahaaga si tirada koorumka lagugu daro.
committee-session.step.2.label: Ajandaha
committee-session.step.2.what: Guddoomiyuhu wuxuu daabacayaa liiska arrimaha uu guddigu wax ka qaban doono.
committee-session.step.2.you: Dib u eeg ajandaha si aad u aragto waxa guddigu tixgelin doono maanta.
committee-session.step.3.label: Markhaati
committee-session.step.3.what: Deganayaasha iyo markhaatiyada la casuumay ayaa ka hadla arrimaha ajandaha ka hor inta uusan guddigu codayn.
committee-session.step.3.you: Gudbi markhaatigaaga haddii aad rabto in mowqifkaagu uu galo diiwaanka.
committee-session.step.4.label: Mooshinka
committee-session.step.4.what: Xubin guddiga ka mid ah ayaa si rasmi ah u soo jeedinaya tallaabo uu guddigu codaynayo.
committee-session.step.4.you: Gudbi mooshinkaaga haddii aad hayso mid aad hortaagayso guddiga.
committee-session.step.5.label: Codeynta guddiga
committee-session.step.5.what: Xubin kasta oo guddiga ka mid ah ayaa codka ka dhiibaya mooshinka hortaagan.
committee-session.step.6.label: Warbixin
committee-session.step.6.what: Guddoomiyuhu wuxuu gudbinayaa warbixin rasmi ah oo diiwaangelinaysa go'aannada iyo talooyinka guddiga.
committee-session.step.6.you: Akhri warbixinta guddiga marka uu guddoomiyuhu gudbiyo.
committee-session.title: Kalfalig guddiga, oo toos ah
court-case.earn: dhageysiga maxkamaddu wuxuu kugu soo dhoweyn doonaa qof aqoon u leh hannaanka
court-case.step.0.label: La gudbiyay
court-case.step.0.what: Degane ama qareen ayaa maxkamadda u gudbinaya kiis madani ah ama mid dambiyeed.
court-case.step.0.you: Kiiskaaga ka gudbi bogga diiwaanka dadweynaha.
court-case.step.1.label: Guddiga garsoorka
court-case.step.1.what: Maxkamaddu waxay aqbalaysaa kiiska, waxayna u xiraysaa guddiga garsooreyaal ah oo dhageysanaya.
court-case.step.1.you: La soco sida maxkamaddu ugu diiwaangeliso xilaynta guddiga bogga garsoorka.
court-case.step.2.label: Dhageysigyo
court-case.step.2.what: Guddigu wuxuu qabanayaa dhageysigyo qorshaysan oo ay imaanayaan dhinacyada iyo markhaatiyada.
court-case.step.2.you: Kiiska ka raac diiwaanka dadweynaha marka kasta oo dhageysi la diiwaangeliyo.
court-case.step.3.label: Cadaymo
court-case.step.3.what: Qareenadu waxay guddiga u gudbinayaan cadaymo dukumiinti ah iyo kuwa markhaati ah.
court-case.step.4.label: Xeerbeegti
court-case.step.4.what: Guddigu wuxuu soo saarayaa amar xulashada xeerbeegtiga, muwaadiniintana waa la xulayaa.
court-case.step.4.you: La soco guddiga marka ay amarka xulashada xeerbeegtiga ku daabacaan bogga garsoorka.
court-case.step.5.label: Doodaha
court-case.step.5.what: Qareenadu waxay gudbiyaan qoraallada xiritaanka, waxayna soo bandhigaan doodaha ugu dambeeya horta guddiga.
court-case.step.5.you: Gudbi qoraalkaaga xiritaanka adigoo isticmaalaya konsoolka qareenka.
court-case.step.6.label: Wada-tashiga
court-case.step.6.what: Guddiga iyo xeerbeegtidu waxay si gaar ah uga wada tashadaan si ay go'aan u gaaraan.
court-case.step.6.you: Sug inta wada-tashigu dhammaanayo ka hor inta aadan hubin diiwaanka dacwadda.
court-case.step.7.label: Xukunka
court-case.step.7.what: Guddigu wuxuu ku dhawaaqaa go'aankiisa, haddii ay jirto, wuxuu soo saaraa amar xukun.
court-case.step.7.you: Akhri xukunka ee diiwaanka dadweynaha ee dacwadda.
court-case.step.8.label: Aragtida
court-case.step.8.what: Guddigu wuxuu gudbiyaa aragti qoran oo sharraxaysa sababta sharciga ah ee xukunka.
court-case.step.8.you: Akhri aragtida la daabacay ee diiwaanka dadweynaha ee dacwadda.
court-case.title: Dacwad maxkamadeed, bilow ilaa dhammaad
election.earn: madasha musharraxaadku waxay kugu soo dhoweyn doonaan qof aqoon u leh hannaanka
election.step.0.label: Ansixinta
election.step.0.what: Deganayaashu waxay arkaan liiska musharraxaadka oo dhan, waxayna calaamadeeyaan kuwa ay ansixiyaan.
election.step.0.you: Furo warqadda codeynta, calaamadee musharrax kasta oo aad ansixiso.
election.step.1.label: Madasha musharraxaadka
election.step.1.what: Musharraxaadku waxay soo bandhigaan barnaamijkooda si deganayaashu wax uga bartaan ka hor codeynta kala horeynta ah.
election.step.1.you: Akhri profile-yada musharraxaadka iyo qoraallada dadweynaha ka hor inta aadan go'aamin kala horeyntaada.
election.step.2.label: Xadka kama-dambaysta
election.step.2.what: Guddiga doorashadu wuxuu xiraa muddada ansixinta, wuxuuna xaqiijiyaa musharraxaadka gudba.
election.step.2.you: La soco liiska kama-dambaysta ee ka soo muuqanaya bogga doorashada.
election.step.3.label: Codeynta kala horeynta
election.step.3.what: Deganayaashu waxay kala horeysiiyaan kama-dambaystayaasha laga bilaabo kan ugu doorbidhan ilaa kan ugu dambeeya.
election.step.3.you: Furo warqadda codeynta kala horeynta, u kala horeysii musharraxaadka sida aad doorbidayso.
election.step.4.label: Tirinta
election.step.4.what: Nidaamku wuxuu tiriyaa dhammaan warqadaha codeynta isagoo isticmaalaya habka codka kaliya ee wareejinta leh.
election.step.4.you: La soco tirinta wareeg-wareegga ah ee bogga natiijada.
election.step.5.label: Kursi fadhiisasho
election.step.5.what: Guddiga doorashadu wuxuu xaqiijiyaa tirinta, guuleystayaashana si rasmi ah ayaa loo fadhiisiyaa.
election.step.5.you: La soco bogga natiijada si aad u xaqiijiso guuleystayaasha la aqoonsaday.
election.step.6.label: Kalfadhiga koowaad
election.step.6.what: Golaha cusub ayaa markii ugu horreysay kulmaya, xubin kastaana waxay qaadaysaa dhaar xilka.
election.step.6.you: La soco xubin kasta oo aqbalaysa kursigeeda oo qaadaysa dhaarta.
election.title: Doorasho, bilow ilaa dhammaad
election.your_part: kan ayaad u codeynaysaa — ansixi musharraxaadka aad aaminto, ka dibna kala horeysii marka muddadu furanto
form-a-group.earn: kulanka kooxdu waxay kugu soo dhoweyn doonaan qof aqoon u leh hannaanka
form-a-group.step.0.label: Abuur
form-a-group.step.0.what: Qof ayaa ka diiwaangeliya koox aan rasmi ahayn diiwaanka ururka.
form-a-group.step.0.you: Fur bogga ururrada oo diiwaangeli kooxda.
form-a-group.step.1.label: Ka dood
form-a-group.step.1.what: Xubnaha kooxdu waxay fariimaha ku qoraan fagaaraha dadweynaha.
form-a-group.step.1.you: Qor fikirkaaga oo akhri waxa ay kuwa kale qoreen.
form-a-group.step.2.label: Kala shir qabo
form-a-group.step.2.what: Xubin ayaa xilliga dejisa, waxayna ku martiqaadtaa inta kale ee kooxda inay kulmaan.
form-a-group.step.2.you: Dir martiqaadka qolka gaarka ah ee kooxda.
form-a-group.step.3.label: Go'aami
form-a-group.step.3.what: Kooxdu waxay gaartaa heshiis, qofna wuu diiwaangeliyaa.
form-a-group.step.3.you: Qor go'aanka si xubin kasta ay u aragto.
form-a-group.step.4.label: Tallaabooyinka xiga (ikhtiyaari)
form-a-group.step.4.what: Kooxdu waxay u beddeli kartaa urur rasmi ah ama waxay bilaabi kartaa codsi.
form-a-group.step.4.you: Dooro tallaabada xigta ee diiwaanka ururrada ama bogga codsiyada.
form-a-group.title: Koox aan rasmi ahayn ayaa samaysanta oo kulanta
form-a-group.your_part: tan adiga ayaa samaynaya — bilow kooxda, martiqaad dariskaaga, oo u yeer kulanka ugu horreeya
generic.arc_rooms: raac qaabka hoose — ka daawo gallery-ga, ama hadal marka aad tahay degane
mutual-aid.earn: kulanka kooxdu waxay kugu soo dhoweyn doonaan qof aqoon u leh nidaamka
mutual-aid.step.0.label: Qor codsi
mutual-aid.step.0.what: Qof ayaa suuqa furan ku qora baahi caawimo ah.
mutual-aid.step.0.you: Fur suuqa furan oo qor liiska waxaad u baahan tahay.
mutual-aid.step.1.label: Dariska ayaa ka jawaaba
mutual-aid.step.1.what: Degane kale ayaa arka codsiga oo bixiya caawimo.
mutual-aid.step.2.label: Isku dubarid
mutual-aid.step.2.what: Laba qof ayaa ku heshiiya sida caawimada loo bixin doono.
mutual-aid.step.2.you: Isweydaarsada fariimaha qol gaar ah si aad faahfaahinta u habaynta.
mutual-aid.step.3.label: Waa la xalliyay
mutual-aid.step.3.what: Codsiga waa la xalliyay, liiskuna waa la xiray.
mutual-aid.step.3.you: Fur liiska oo calaamadi codsiga inuu dhammaaday.
mutual-aid.title: Weydiisashada iyo bixinta caawimada
mutual-aid.your_part: tan adiga ayaa samaynaya — qor codsi caawimo ah, ama ka jawaab midka dariskaaga
petition-to-referendum.earn: hoolka aftidu waxay kugu soo dhoweyn doonaan qof aqoon u leh nidaamka
petition-to-referendum.step.0.label: Codsi
petition-to-referendum.step.0.what: Degane ayaa gudbiya codsi si su'aal loo horgeliyo golaha sharci-dejinta.
petition-to-referendum.step.0.you: Fur bogga codsiyada oo gudbi qoraalka codsiga.
petition-to-referendum.step.1.label: Saxiixyada
petition-to-referendum.step.1.what: Deganayaashu waxay saxiixaan codsiga ilaa uu ka gaaro xadka loo baahan yahay.
petition-to-referendum.step.1.you: Raadi codsiga oo ku dar saxiixaaga.
petition-to-referendum.step.2.label: Wuxuu gaarayaa golaha sharci-dejinta
petition-to-referendum.step.2.what: Guddiga doorashadu wuxuu xaqiijinayaa tirada saxiixyada, wuxuuna codsiga u diraa golaha sharci-dejinta.
petition-to-referendum.step.2.you: La soco xaaladda codsiga ee bogga codsiyada si aad u hesho ogeysiiska xaqiijinta.
petition-to-referendum.step.3.label: Afti
petition-to-referendum.step.3.what: Golaha sharci-dejintu wuxuu u codeeyaa in su'aasha si toos ah loogu diro deganayaasha si ay go'aan uga gaaraan.
petition-to-referendum.step.3.you: La soco golaha sharci-dejinta marka ay bixinayaan codka wakiilka ee bogga aftiyada.
petition-to-referendum.step.4.label: Hoolka magaalada
petition-to-referendum.step.4.what: Deganayaashu waxay qabtaan dood dadweyne oo ku saabsan su'aasha ka hor intaan la codayn.
petition-to-referendum.step.4.you: Ku qor markhaatigaaga ama akhri waxa dadka kale ay ku yiraahdeen fagaaraha dadweynaha.
petition-to-referendum.step.5.label: Codey
petition-to-referendum.step.5.what: Deganayaasha xaqqa u leh waxay bixiyaan cod 'haa' ama 'maya' ah oo ku saabsan su'aasha aftida.
petition-to-referendum.step.5.you: Fura aftida ee bogga aftiyada oo bixi codkaaga.
petition-to-referendum.step.6.label: Natiijada
petition-to-referendum.step.6.what: Tirinta ayaa xiranta, natiijadana waa la daabacaa.
petition-to-referendum.title: Laga bilaabo codsi ilaa afti
petition-to-referendum.your_part: tan ayaad samaynaysaa — saxiix (ama bilow) codsiga, ka dibna codey marka aftidu furanto
public-service.earn: kalfaliga sharci-dejintu wuxuu kugu soo dhoweyn doonaa qof aqoon u leh hannaanka
public-service.step.0.label: Charter CGC
public-service.step.0.what: Golaha sharci-dejintu wuxuu ansixiyaa go'aan lagu abuurayo Shirkadda Danta Guud si ay adeeg ugu fidiso qof kasta oo jooga xuduud awoodeedka.
public-service.step.0.you: La soco hindise sharciga marka uu marayo akhrisyada golaha oo uu noqonayo go'aanka aasaaska shirkadda.
public-service.step.1.label: Guddiga Maamulka
public-service.step.1.what: Fulintu waxay magacaabaysaa xubnaha guddiga maamulka ee shirkadda, golaha sharci-dejintuna wuxuu u codeeyaa si uu u xaqiijiyo.
public-service.step.1.you: La soco magacaabista marka ay gaarto fulinta iyo codka ogolaanshaha ee fadhiisinaya guddiga maamulka.
public-service.step.2.label: Waxay u adeegtaa dadweynaha
public-service.step.2.what: Shirkaddu waxay bilaabaysaa hawlgalka, adeegkeeduna wuxuu u furan yahay degane kasta oo jooga xuduud awoodeedka.
public-service.step.2.you: Ka raadi ururka diiwaanka si aad u akhriso diiwaan dadweyne oo aad u aragto xaaladdiisa firfircoon.
public-service.step.3.label: Waddada keligood haysashada (ikhtiyaari)
public-service.step.3.what: Golaha sharci-dejintu wuxuu u codeeyaa in shirkadda la siiyo xuquuq keligood ah oo ku saabsan aagga adeeggeeda.
public-service.step.3.you: La soco codka helitaanka keligood haysashada oo arag diiwaanka ururka oo cusboonaaday.
public-service.title: Dawlad ayaa abuurta adeeg dadweyne
start-org.earn: kulanka guddiga maamulku wuxuu kugu soo dhoweyn doonaa qof aqoon u leh hannaanka
start-org.step.0.label: Diiwaangeli
start-org.step.0.what: Degane ayaa dawladda kula diiwaangelinaya urur cusub.
start-org.step.0.you: Diiwaangeli ururkaaga adigoo isticmaalaya diiwaanka ururrada.
start-org.step.1.label: Charter
start-org.step.1.what: Xubnaha aasaasaya ayaa dejinaya magaca ururka, ujeeddada, iyo xeerarka maamulka.
start-org.step.1.you: Buuxi faahfaahinta charter-ka ee bogga profile-ka ururka.
start-org.step.2.label: Guddiga ugu horreeya
start-org.step.2.what: Xubnaha aasaasaya ayaa dooranaya guddiga maamulka ee ugu horreeya.
start-org.step.2.you: Maamul doorashada guddiga ugu horreeya adigoo isticmaalaya bogga ururka.
start-org.step.3.label: Ku soo biir
start-org.step.3.what: Xubnaha ugu horreeya ayaa codsanaya inay ku biiraan ururka cusub ee la dhisay.
start-org.step.4.label: Suuqa (ikhtiyaari)
start-org.step.4.what: Ururku wuxuu si ikhtiyaari ah isugu diiwaangelinayaa inuu wax ku iibsado ama ku iibiyo suuqa furan.
start-org.step.4.you: Gudbi foomka ka qaybgalka suuqa bogga ururrada.
start-org.title: Bilowga urur
start-org.your_part: tan adiga ayaa samaynaya — diiwaangeli ururka, qor axdiga, oo fadhiisi guddiga maamulka ugu horreeya
stipend-and-tax.earn: meelaha aad tallaabadan ku marto waxay kugu soo dhoweyn doonaan qof aqoon u leh nidaamka
stipend-and-tax.step.0.label: Bixinta gunnooyinka
stipend-and-tax.step.0.what: Saacadda dawladdu waxay kiciyaysaa bixinta gunnooyinka madaniga ah ee deggane kasta oo u qalma.
stipend-and-tax.step.0.you: Furo bogga gunnooyinka si aad u aragto bixinta hadda socota, jadwalkeeda, iyo qadarka deggane kasta loo bixiyay.
stipend-and-tax.step.1.label: Rasiidkaaga
stipend-and-tax.step.1.what: Qadarka gunnadu wuxuu ku soo dhacayaa boorsadaada isla marka ay bixintu dhammaato.
stipend-and-tax.step.1.you: Furo boorsadaada si aad u xaqiijiso dhigashada oo aad ugu raacdo diiwaanka guud ee bixinta gunnooyinka.
stipend-and-tax.step.2.label: Gudbinta canshuurta
stipend-and-tax.step.2.what: Qayb ka mid ah dakhligaaga waxaad u diraysaa khasnadda dadweynaha sida lacag canshuur ah.
stipend-and-tax.step.2.you: Isticmaal foomka wareejinta lacagta si aad lacagta ugu dirto akoonka dawladda.
stipend-and-tax.step.3.label: Diiwaanka guud
stipend-and-tax.step.3.what: Rasiid kasta iyo kharash kasta oo dawladdu samayso waa la diiwaangeliyaa, waana u furan yahay deggane kasta inuu akhriyo.
stipend-and-tax.step.3.you: Akhri bogga khasnadda si aad u aragto diiwaanka maaliyadeed ee guud ee xuduud awoodeedka.
stipend-and-tax.title: Lacagta u dhaxaysa qofka iyo dawladiisa
stipend-and-tax.your_part: tan adiga ayaa kuu imaanaysa — gunnadu waxay ku soo dhacaysaa boorsadaada, adiguna waxaad iskugu gudbinaysaa canshuurta
two-governments.earn: aftida hoolka dadweynaha waxay kugu soo dhoweyn doonaan qof aqoon u leh nidaamka
two-governments.step.0.label: Raadi saaxiib
two-governments.step.0.what: Xuduud awoodeed ayaa raadinaysa dawlad kale oo ku jirta shabakadda federaalka, waxayna akhrinaysaa sharraxaaddeeda guud.
two-governments.step.0.you: Furo bogga federaalka si aad u aragto xuduudaha awoodeed ee saaxiibada ah iyo xaaladda xiriirkooda.
two-governments.step.1.label: Isku kalsoonaada diiwaannada
two-governments.step.1.what: Labada dawladood waxay xaqiijinayaan oo aqbalayaan diiwaannada sirta ah ee midba midka kale inay yihiin kuwa rasmi ah.
two-governments.step.1.you: La soco bogga xaaladda federaalka marka xiriirka saaxiibnimadu uu xaqiijiyo labada dhinacba.
two-governments.step.2.label: Wada-hadallada ganacsiga
two-governments.step.2.what: Wakiillada labada xuduud awoodeed waxay gorgortamayaan, waxayna saxiixayaan heshiis rasmi ah oo xuduudeed.
two-governments.step.2.you: Dib u eeg qabyo-qoraalka heshiiska bogga heshiisyada, oo saxiix marka shuruudaha la isku raaco.
two-governments.step.3.label: Midow ama xuduud
two-governments.step.3.what: Golaha sharci-dejinta ayaa u codeynaya inay midow la sameystaan xuduud awoodeedka saaxiibka ah ama inay xalliyaan xuduudda ay wadaagaan.
two-governments.step.3.you: La soco codeynta dhismaha midowga ee qolkaaga ama akhri natiijada xuduudda ee diiwaanka xuduud awoodeedka.
two-governments.title: Laba dawladood ayaa kulmaya, ganacsanaya, oo midoobaya
